title: Python Taster Session
description: Learn what Python is, and see the tools we use to teach at Headstart Coding!

tasks.title: What is Python?
tasks.explainer:
**Python** is a **programming language**. 

It is used to make **games**, **apps**, **websites** and even **control robots!**

tasks.title: Printing Your Name
tasks.explainer:
When we want to print to the screen we use `python:print()` - Anything inside the brackets will be printed to the console! 

But we also need to put our message inside **quotation marks** `python:print(" ")`

Try it below, put *between* the quotation marks your name: 
```python
print("Your name")

tasks.title: Printing Hello World!
tasks.explainer:
Can you write a `python:print()` command from scratch? 

Try writing out the code from below: 

```python
print("Hello world")
```

tasks.title: Creating a Variable
tasks.explainer:
We can use **variables** to store information. 

Create a variable with **your name** in with the following code: 

```python
name = "Ryan"
```

tasks.title: Printing a Variable
tasks.explainer:
We can then **print** our **variable** using the `python:print()` function!

Because it is a **variable** we don't need to put it in quotation marks. Write out what is below *on the next line*. 

```python
print(name)
```
